policy.authority: JSON status contract; legacy tracker details are checked against it; GENERATED markdown is rendered from JSON
policy.generic_acceptance: current-season ZERO-SOURCE + source-driven alternative season/build/ID regression, where applicable; no future unreleased season required
policy.current_source_acceptance: actual current game-build provider source + exact SHA + correct consumed scope
policy.product_acceptance: actual user input through season environment and SimC DPS/SEM/95% output; separate final product E2E
policy.optional_acceptance: NOT_APPLICABLE only with concrete feature-specific reason and owner evidence; no blanket exemptions
